# Andrei Filatov

> Research scientist and ML/DL engineer, Member of Technical Staff at Krea.
> Previously Kandinsky Labs, VILAB (EPFL) and the Samsung AI Center.
> Writes long-form technical essays on machine learning, GPU architecture, and inference,
> in Russian and English. Also runs the Russian-language Telegram channel t.me/awesome_dl.

Every page on this site has a markdown twin at the same path with a `.md` extension.
`llms-full.txt` contains the whole site as a single document.

## About

- [About Andrei Filatov](https://anvilarth.github.io/about.md): background, current work at Krea, publications, contacts

## Posts

- [Age of Autoresearch (RU)](https://anvilarth.github.io/autoresearch.md): how expertise moves from finding a solution to building the loop that finds it — autoresearch, agent-run experiment loops, oracles and stopping criteria, and what remains for the human
- [Age of Autoresearch (EN)](https://anvilarth.github.io/autoresearch.en.md): English version of the autoresearch essay
- [How a thing that drew triangles became the most important chip on the planet (RU)](https://anvilarth.github.io/gpu-story.md): the GPU from fixed-function triangle rasterizer to the chip the AI industry runs on — rasterization, shaders, CUDA, tensor cores, memory hierarchy
- [How a thing that drew triangles became the most important chip on the planet (EN)](https://anvilarth.github.io/gpu-story.en.md): English version of the GPU essay

## Tools

- [Realtime Video Generation Calculator](https://anvilarth.github.io/realtime-video-calculator.html): interactive estimate of when video generation becomes real-time
